initial_inventory.title: [Model] Screen FP8 drafting with a private NVFP4 candidate head

metadata.title: [Model] Screen FP8 drafting with a private NVFP4 candidate head
metadata.body:
## Purpose

Use a private NVFP4 proposal-head copy for SM70 DFlash2 draft7, while target verification retains its original per-channel FP8 weights and head. The real selector uses seven rows; both M7 and M8 fit one tile. Larger batches retain the original head. Quantization runs once in bounded row chunks before graph capture.

The projection changes are from merged #954. This PR adds the proposal head and its Model Runner V1/V2 preparation, rather than duplicating that projection change.

## Test Plan

Check target weight/scales immutability, graph replay, zero rows, partial packing chunks and batch/strided-input fallback. Use a complete ordinary SM70 wheel with no private runtime library overlays. Measure same-service 256K startup, 1K/8K inputs, temperature 0.7, top-p 0.9, top-k 20, thinking off, seed 123, eight prompts with 600 tokens each. Compare prompt-level acceptance confidence intervals, natural EOS and warmed C4 throughput.

## Test Result

Four focused GPU tests pass. Fresh installed-artifact native dependency validation passes. The original complete CUDA source build is reused only for a Python correction: all sixteen native DSOs are byte-identical, native source/build configuration is unchanged, wheel RECORD is regenerated, and corrected Python matches the tested source. Ruff and source checks pass.

| Same-service route | 1K ms/round | 8K ms/round |
|---|---:|---:|
| Original FP16 draft projections/head | 14.587 | 14.998 |
| Private proposal head only | 14.385 | 14.788 |
| FP8 projections + private proposal head | 13.939 | 14.354 |

Combined tokens/round are 3.011 [2.868, 3.154] at 1K and 2.840 [2.741, 2.952] at 8K; each 95% prompt-bootstrap interval overlaps its control. Three natural prompts terminate normally. The eight-row draft graph selects exactly one private head kernel; captured draft graph count remains 142.

The initial cumulative C4 comparison passed, but the required incremental comparison against FP8-only main fails: baseline before/after 430.44/436.41 token/s versus 381.73 with the private head. The candidate has more long rounds despite similar median round time. A targeted repeat with CPU-only observation of existing reference flags gives 431.24 → 450.32 token/s, while full-batch reference rounds are 11/190 versus 10/194. The conflicting concurrency results are unresolved; the repeat does not invalidate the observed regression. Keep this PR in Draft; the head is not admitted for production.

Assisted by Codex.
